stated: The Conservative Party will lift the cap on faith schools, allowing them to offer more places to children based on faith and encouraging their expansion.

source.quote: We will lift the cap on faith schools, allowing them to offer more places to children based on faith and encouraging them to expand.

bearing_set.reason: Lifting the cap directly determines how state-funded school places are allocated, affecting access to education for non-faith families, school segregation, and the attainment gap.
Allowing publicly funded schools to select 100% of pupils by religious criteria raises a non-negligible equal treatment question for families of different or no faith under anti-discrimination law.

Higher proportions of faith-selected pupils in expanded faith schools affect religious and socioeconomic integration; credible evidence links high faith-selection to community segregation, making community cohesion a non-negligible bearing.

membership_note: Three fundamentals earn real verdicts: O7 (supply and equity of school places), O9 (religious discrimination in state-funded admissions), and O15 (segregation and inter-group cohesion). Other candidates — O12, O13, O14 — are either too indirect or subsumed within O7's attainment-gap indicator.
